title.zh: 把格点距离与同色条件写成整数公式
title.en: Express lattice distances and equal colors arithmetically

given.zh: 用两个整数坐标定义三角格点 $P(a,b)$，并取颜色 $(a-2b)\bmod 7$。
given.en: Define triangular lattice points $P(a,b)$ and assign the residue $(a-2b)\bmod 7$.

claim.zh: 若 $p=a-c$、$q=b-d$，则两格点距离的平方为 $(9/16)Q(p,q)$；两格点同色当且仅当 $7$ 整除 $p-2q$。
claim.en: For $p=a-c$ and $q=b-d$, the squared distance is $(9/16)Q(p,q)$; the colors agree exactly when seven divides $p-2q$.

reason.zh: 两个格点的坐标公式逐项相减，把四个整数变量化成一个整数差向量。
reason.en: Subtract the coordinate formulas to reduce four integer variables to one integer difference vector.
Expand the squares: the $q^2$ coefficient is $9/64+27/64=9/16$ and the cross term is $9pq/16$.

reason.zh: 颜色是模 $7$ 的剩余类；两个剩余类相等，恰好要求它们的整数差为 $7$ 的倍数。
reason.en: Colors are residue classes modulo seven, whose equality is equivalent to divisibility of the integer difference by seven.

title.zh: 不同同色格点的距离大于 1+2r
title.en: Distinct centers of one color are farther apart than 1+2r

given.zh: 两个格点同色且坐标对不同，所以 $(p,q)\ne(0,0)$，并有 $p-2q=7k$。
given.en: The points have one color and different coordinate pairs, so $(p,q)\ne(0,0)$ and $p-2q=7k$.

claim.zh: $Q(p,q)\ge 7$，因此格点距离的平方至少为 $63/16$，距离严格大于 $1+2r$。
claim.en: $Q(p,q)\ge 7$, so the squared distance is at least $63/16$ and the distance is strictly greater than $1+2r$.

reason.zh: 把整除条件给出的整数 $k$ 代入 $Q=p^2+pq+q^2$，再展开并提出因子 $7$。
reason.en: Substitute the integer $k$ from divisibility into $Q=p^2+pq+q^2$, expand, and factor out seven.

statement.zh: $4Q=(2p+q)^2+3q^2>0$；$Q$ 是正整数且为 $7$ 的倍数，所以 $Q\ge 7$。
statement.en: $4Q=(2p+q)^2+3q^2>0$. Since $Q$ is a positive integer divisible by seven, $Q\ge 7$.

reason.zh: 若右端为零，则 $q=0$、$p=0$，与中心坐标对不同矛盾；正的 $7$ 倍数最小为 $7$。
reason.en: If the right side vanished, both $q$ and $p$ would be zero, contradicting distinct coordinate pairs. The least positive multiple of seven is seven.

reason.zh: 将整数下界送入格点距离公式，乘上正系数 $9/16$，不等号方向不变。
reason.en: Insert the integer lower bound into the distance formula and multiply by positive $9/16$.

reason.zh: 这里 $r=\sqrt{3}/4$ 为非负实数，$r<1/2$ 由 $3<4$ 得到；两边距离非负，比较平方即可推出 $\mathrm{dist}>1+2r$。
reason.en: Here $r=\sqrt{3}/4\ge 0$, and $r<1/2$ follows from $3<4$. Both distances are nonnegative, so comparison of squares yields $\mathrm{dist}>1+2r$.

title.zh: 在斜坐标的四个整数角中找覆盖格点
title.en: Find a covering center among four integer corners

given.zh: 任取 $x=(X,Y)$，反解斜坐标 $\alpha=4X/3-4Y/(3\sqrt{3})$、$\beta=8Y/(3\sqrt{3})$，取小数部分 $p,q\in[0,1)$。
given.en: For $x=(X,Y)$, invert the lattice coordinates: $\alpha=4X/3-4Y/(3\sqrt{3})$, $\beta=8Y/(3\sqrt{3})$. Their fractional parts $p,q$ lie in $[0,1)$.

claim.zh: 在 $(\lfloor\alpha\rfloor,\lfloor\beta\rfloor)$ 的四个相邻整数角中，存在 $(m,n)$ 使 $\mathrm{dist}(x,P(m,n))\le r$。
claim.en: One of the four integer corners adjacent to $(\lfloor\alpha\rfloor,\lfloor\beta\rfloor)$ satisfies $\mathrm{dist}(x,P(m,n))\le r$.

reason.zh: 直接代回两个线性式，得到任意平面点的实斜坐标，而不是先假设该点属于格点。
reason.en: Substitution verifies these two linear equations, giving real oblique coordinates for any plane point without assuming it is a lattice point.

statement.en: Let $p=\alpha-\lfloor\alpha\rfloor$ and $q=\beta-\lfloor\beta\rfloor$ lie in $[0,1)$. The four corner errors are $(p,q)$, $(p-1,q)$, $(p,q-1)$, $(p-1,q-1)$.

reason.zh: 分别选择每个坐标的下整数或上整数，便把找任意整数中心的问题缩成四个具体候选。
reason.en: Choose either floor or floor plus one in each coordinate, reducing the search for an integer center to four explicit candidates.

reason.zh: 平方是凸函数，线性式的平方与非负加权和仍凸。多边形内任一点都是顶点的凸组合，所以函数值不超过顶点值的最大值；下面用这个事实读出 $1/3$ 的具体来源。
reason.en: Squares of linear forms and their nonnegative sums are convex. Every point of a polygon is a convex combination of its vertices, so its value is bounded by the largest vertex value. This explains the numerical bound $1/3$ below.

statement.en: Region $00$ is $p,q\ge 0$, $2p+q\le 1$, $p+2q\le 1$. Its successive vertices are $(0,0)$, $(1/2,0)$, $(1/3,1/3)$, $(0,1/2)$, with $Q$ values $0, 1/4, 1/3, 1/4$.

reason.zh: 把相邻边界联立得到四个顶点，再逐一代入 $Q$。凸性使整个区域都有 $Q(p,q)\le 1/3$；这就是 corner00 使用的不等式。
reason.en: Intersect adjacent boundary lines to find the four vertices and substitute them into $Q$. Convexity gives $Q(p,q)\le 1/3$ throughout the region, the inequality used in corner00.

statement.en: Choose corner $(0,0)$ in region $00$. If $2p+q\ge 2$ and $p+2q\ge 2$, choose $(1,1)$, with $Q(p-1,q-1)\le 1/3$.

reason.zh: 第二种情形令 $u=1-p$、$v=1-q$，则 $u,v\ge 0$、$2u+v\le 1$、$u+2v\le 1$，落入 $00$ 区域。又 $Q(p-1,q-1)=Q(u,v)$，所以 corner11 由同一个 $1/3$ 上界得到。
reason.en: In the second case set $u=1-p$, $v=1-q$. Then $u,v\ge 0$, $2u+v\le 1$ and $u+2v\le 1$, putting them in region $00$. Since $Q(p-1,q-1)=Q(u,v)$, the same bound proves corner11.

statement.en: Outside regions $00$ and $11$, $q\le p$ gives $1\le 2p+q$ and $p+2q\le 2$, selecting $(1,0)$; when $p\le q$ select $(0,1)$.

reason.zh: $q\le p$ 使 $2p+q\ge p+2q$：排除 $00$ 迫使较大者大于 $1$，排除 $11$ 迫使较小者小于 $2$。交换 $p$、$q$ 得到另一支；全序比较保证剩下的点都进入其中一支。
reason.en: When $q\le p$, $2p+q\ge p+2q$. Excluding $00$ forces the larger expression above one, and excluding $11$ forces the smaller below two. Swap $p$ and $q$ for the other branch; their total order covers every remaining point.

reason.zh: 这五条线性界恰是 corner10 的假设；相邻边界相交得到所列五边形。它包含前一行 $q\le p$ 分支的全部点，因此还需在这个区域上估计对应误差。
reason.en: These five linear bounds are precisely the assumptions of corner10. Adjacent boundary intersections give the listed pentagon, containing the entire $q\le p$ branch from the preceding line.

statement.en: At these five vertices, $Q(p-1,q)$ has values $1/4, 0, 1/4, 1/3, 1/3$. Thus $Q(p-1,q)\le 1/3$ throughout region $10$.

reason.zh: 逐点代入平移后的二次型，再用其凸性将顶点界传到整个五边形。这给出了选择右下角 $(1,0)$ 时的覆盖估计。
reason.en: Evaluate the translated quadratic form at each vertex and use convexity to extend their bound to the whole pentagon. This gives the covering estimate for corner $(1,0)$.

statement.en: Swapping $p$ and $q$ maps branch $01$ into region $10$, and $Q(p,q-1)=Q(q-1,p)\le 1/3$.

reason.zh: $Q$ 对两个变量对称；交换后的五条假设就是 corner01 调用 corner10 时的条件。因此左上角 $(0,1)$ 也已覆盖，并与 $00$、$11$、$10$ 一起穷尽整个方格。
reason.en: The form $Q$ is symmetric in its two variables. The swapped five hypotheses are exactly those used when corner01 invokes corner10. This covers corner $(0,1)$ and, together with $00$, $11$ and $10$, exhausts the square.

reason.zh: 使用实斜坐标的距离公式与已选角的 $Q$ 界，再由距离和 $r$ 均非负取平方根，得到 $\mathrm{dist}\le r$。
reason.en: Use the distance formula in real oblique coordinates and the chosen corner bound. Since distance and $r$ are nonnegative, take square roots to obtain $\mathrm{dist}\le r$.

title.zh: 定义全平面着色并保留覆盖证据
title.en: Define the plane coloring together with its covering bound

given.zh: covering 已为每个点 $x$ 提供整数 $a,b$，满足 $\mathrm{dist}(x,P(a,b))\le r$。
given.en: covering supplies integers $a,b$ with $\mathrm{dist}(x,P(a,b))\le r$ for every $x$.

claim.zh: $\mathrm{triColor}(x)$ 取所选格点的颜色。每个 $x$ 都同时具有距中心不超过 $r$、颜色等于中心颜色这两条性质；并且 $r<1/2$。
claim.en: $\mathrm{triColor}(x)$ is its chosen center’s color. Every point is within $r$ of a center of its color, and $r<1/2$.

statement.zh: 为每个 $x$ 固定覆盖见证 $a_x,b_x$，记 $C_x=P(a_x,b_x)$；则 $\mathrm{dist}(x,C_x)\le r$。
statement.en: For each $x$ fix covering witnesses $a_x,b_x$ and put $C_x=P(a_x,b_x)$, with $\mathrm{dist}(x,C_x)\le r$.

reason.zh: Classical.choose 选取整数见证，choose_spec 同时保留距离界；定义着色后仍能取回这条证据。
reason.en: Classical.choose selects the integer witnesses, while choose_spec retains the distance bound so it remains available after defining the coloring.

reason.zh: 颜色直接取所选中心的模 $7$ 颜色；因此每个点都能拿出一个与自己同色、距离不超过 $r$ 的中心。
reason.en: Assign the modulo-seven color of the chosen center. Every point thus has a center of the same color within distance $r$.

reason.zh: 这个严格不等式将用于排除同一中心覆盖两个单位距离点；它与前面较大的同色中心间隔分别控制两种情况。
reason.en: This strict inequality excludes two unit-distance points sharing a center. Together with the larger equal-color center separation, it controls the two cases separately.

title.zh: 同一个覆盖格点容不下单位距离的两点
title.en: A shared covering center excludes distance one

reason.zh: 把同一个中心代入两份覆盖证据，并用距离对称性使两条路段首尾相接。
reason.en: Use the shared center in both covering bounds and symmetry of distance to join the two segments.

reason.zh: 三角不等式将单位距离压到严格小于一，故两个所选中心的整数坐标对不能相同。
reason.en: The triangle inequality makes the unit distance strictly less than one, so the integer coordinate pairs of the chosen centers cannot agree.

title.zh: 不同同色中心也与单位距离矛盾
title.en: Distinct equal-color centers give the final contradiction

given.zh: 两个中心不同；triColor 的相等和中心颜色等式给出 $\mathrm{colorOf}(a,b)=\mathrm{colorOf}(c,d)$。
given.en: The centers differ. Equality of triColor and the center-color identities imply $\mathrm{colorOf}(a,b)=\mathrm{colorOf}(c,d)$.

claim.zh: 单位距离的点必异色，因此 triColor 见证 $\mathrm{ProperColoring}\,7$。
claim.en: Points at distance one have different colors, so triColor witnesses $\mathrm{ProperColoring}\,7$.

reason.zh: 分别展开两点颜色等于所选中心颜色的定义，使平面点的同色假设变成格点的同色条件。
reason.en: Expand each point’s color as its chosen center’s color, converting the plane-color assumption into equality of lattice colors.

reason.zh: 严格下界来自同色格点分离；上界沿 $C_x\to x\to y\to C_y$ 使用两次三角不等式和两份覆盖界。
reason.en: The strict lower bound comes from equal-color lattice separation. The upper bound follows along $C_x\to x\to y\to C_y$ from two triangle inequalities and the covering bounds.

statement.zh: 中心相同与不同两支都矛盾，故 $\mathrm{dist}(x,y)=1 \Rightarrow \mathrm{triColor}(x)\ne\mathrm{triColor}(y)$；取这个 triColor 作为七色着色。
statement.en: Both center cases contradict equal colors, so $\mathrm{dist}(x,y)=1$ implies $\mathrm{triColor}(x)\ne\mathrm{triColor}(y)$. Use triColor as the seven-color witness.

reason.zh: 前一步排除了相同坐标对，本步排除了不同坐标对，穷尽所有可能，正好得到 $\mathrm{ProperColoring}\,7$ 的要求。
reason.en: The previous step excluded equal coordinate pairs and this step excludes unequal pairs, exhausting the possibilities and establishing $\mathrm{ProperColoring}\,7$.
